        raise ValueError("Input must be a positive integer")

    gsl.gsl_multiset_alloc.argtypes = [ctypes.c_size_t, ctypes.c_size_t]
    gsl.gsl_multiset_alloc.restype = ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_void_p)

    # Define the free function to release memory
    gsl.gsl_multiset_free.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_void_p)]
    gsl.gsl_multiset_free.restype = None

    # Allocate the multiset
    k = 2  # Example value for k, adjust as needed
    multiset = gsl.gsl_multiset_alloc(n, k)
    if not multiset:
        raise MemoryError("Failed to allocate memory for multiset")

    try:
        # Perform operations on the multiset (if needed)
        # For this example, we simply return a success code
        return 0  # Replace with actual operation result if applicable
    finally:
        # Free the allocated memory
        gsl.gsl_multiset_free(multiset)
